Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished high fidelity desktop UI screenshot mockup, 1440 by 1122 landscape, of a Hebrew RTL military-geography e-learning lesson. This is a proposed redesign of ONLY the "שלושה סוגי צפון" learning screen inside lesson 6, not a home page. Reference images are visual style references ONLY: retain their cream canvas #F3E9DC with very fine tan contour lines, clean white surfaces, 20px rounded corners, thin #DCCDB2 hairlines, subtle shadows, realistic olive/sand terrain / educational object renders, restrained printed-map visual style, large bold Hebrew Rubik heading, Heebo body, black learning text, olive chrome #38432E, sage selected markers #5B7C5C, orange #D97E2B reserved for action or selected controls. No new palette. Diagram may use existing muted red #e2553a for magnetic north, olive #7a8a3f for grid north, green #5B7C5C for true north, never colored paragraphs or headings. Use correct clean Hebrew RTL text, no gibberish, concise 16-18px body, titles 36px. Flat UI with richly rendered central educational illustration. Keep diagram north generally upward, never mirror maps for RTL. All arrows of the 3 north types originate from ONE shared local point, distinct labelled reference rays, not three destinations or three routes.
Page shell: 80px white header, Hebrew logo "גיאוגרפיה צבאית" top right with compass rose, restrained links at center "בית" "תכנית הלימודים" "תרגול חוזר". White sidebar at far right x1200..1440, title "שיעור 6" orange and "ניווטים" olive, "תוכן השיעור", list "פתיחה", "לפני שמתחילים", selected "עקרונות הניווט", "תכנון ציר", "טכניקות ניווט", "סיכום"; lesson progress and "לימוד" selected, "תרגול", "בדיקת ידע". Main area x64..1116, heading "שלושה סוגי צפון" centered near y120. Main workspace white card x64 y270 width1052 height720. Entire mockup in viewport, straight-on screenshot, not device mockup, no browser address bar, no photography of a computer, no external annotations, no marketing decorations. Make the proposed active interaction legible from visible controls and feedback. Semantic accurate distinction: magnetic = local compass needle / Earth's local field, grid = northward map grid lines, true = geographic North Pole along local meridian. At bottom note "הנתונים להמחשה בלבד".
Concept 1 "שולחן חקר": an object-led discovery workspace, not 3 identical flat text cards and not a conventional tab panel. Short subtitle "שלושה מקורות לכיוון — באותו מקום בשטח". On right third of the white workspace, a compact learning panel headed "חקרו את מקור הצפון", body "לחצו על כלי כדי לגלות לאיזה צפון הוא מתייחס." Below a 3-step checklist with icons and labels "מצפן — צפון מגנטי", "רשת המפה — צפון רשת", "קו אורך — צפון אמיתי"; show the compass explored with green check and selected warm orange border. The left two thirds is a beautiful, large interactive table rendered in an educational isometric style. A lightly tilted realistic cream printed topographic map with a sparse river, olive contours, subtle square north grid. At one single local origin point on the map, three floating overlay rays extend upward, magnified separation clearly marked "הפרדה מוגדלת להמחשה"; endpoints labelled without collision "צפון מגנטי", "צפון אמיתי", "צפון רשת". A tactile bronze / olive compass is at the origin with its muted-red needle highlighted. Above the map toward upper-left a small cream/olive globe shows local meridian and a tiny geographic North Pole star, a thin dashed connector clearly ties its local north tangent to the true ray. A translucent upright grid-sheet overlay ties vertical grid lines to the grid ray. Object hotspots are small orange outline circles and subtle touch cues, not arbitrary giant buttons. Active compass is prominent, globe and grid calm but visible. A tiny tooltip beside compass "המחט מתיישרת עם השדה המגנטי המקומי". Right selected explanation "צפון מגנטי" bold black and short text "הכיוון שמורה מחט המצפן. משתנה לפי המקום והזמן." Bottom right orange button "הציגו את שלושתם יחד" and a quiet reset. Bottom workspace insight strip "שלוש נקודות ייחוס שונות — לא שלושה יעדים שונים." Generous whitespace, illustration-driven, elegant credible spatial visual, no floating meaningless 3D layers.

Concept 2 "מעבדת כיוון": an interactive experiment with reference angles, substantially different from concept1. Subtitle "אותו יעד. אזימוט שונה לפי הצפון שממנו מודדים." Dominant FLAT top-down printable map occupies left 65% of card, no globe, no floating terrain. Map has tan contours, faint sage grid tilted 2 degrees clockwise from page up, white round origin A near bottom-middle and one orange destination B near upper-right. ONE fixed orange route ray A to B, world direction 66deg clockwise from true page-up, three local reference rays at origin labelled TN true straight page-up, GN grid at +2deg, MN magnetic at -6deg (small accurate separation, not misleading hugely separated angles). On the map a large elegant bronze compass/measurement circular dial around A with grip on reference ring, physically tangible but mainly crisp readable chart, translucent shaded arc from selected reference to fixed target, clear drag cursor gripping measurement ring. A magnified small inset at map upper-left shows the three north rays distinctly, label "הפרדה מוגדלת". On the right 33%, a calm control panel "שנו את נקודת הייחוס" with 3 compact choice buttons "צפון אמיתי", "צפון רשת", "צפון מגנטי"; active magnetic orange outline. Huge clean readout "072°" with text "האזימוט ביחס לצפון מגנטי". Below muted comparison table "אמיתי 066°", "רשת 064°", "מגנטי 072°" with digits LTR correctly aligned. Bottom right slider labelled "סטייה מגנטית לדוגמה" handle at "-6°", track ticks -10° 0° +10°, body "הזיזו את המחוון וצפו במדידה." Pin fixed "צפון רשת: 2°". Numbers exact and coherent: true north0, grid+2, magnetic-6; target true bearing66 => grid64, magnetic72. Bottom workspace banner in pale cream with large clear black takeaway "היעד לא זז — רק תחילת המדידה משתנה". Small orange button "נסו בעצמכם" and neutral reset "איפוס". Include tiny note "דוגמה לימודית, לא נתוני שטח". No invented live real-world location/time data, not teaching blanket add/subtract rule. Huge educational clarity, strong selected state, scale rings sophisticated restrained, no HUD no sci-fi.

Concept 3 "משימת בחירה": a decision-based microlearning activity with explain-after-answer feedback, no slider, no tabbed glossary, visually different from the first two. Subtitle "איזה צפון מתאים למשימה שלכם?" Card top has 3 compact chronological mission chips in RTL "1 מדידה במצפן" "2 תכנון במפה" "3 ייחוס גאוגרפי", with second currently active, first completed check; no score badges no childish game. Right third white card area: scenario title "מתכננים כיוון על מפת רשת" bold black, concise text "אתם מודדים אזימוט מנקודה A ליעד B באמצעות קווי הרשת. מאיזה צפון מתחילה המדידה?" Three large plain white answer buttons vertically "צפון מגנטי" "צפון רשת" "צפון אמיתי", correct grid selected with sage border and check, bold black title. Beneath show calm pale sage feedback panel with black text, no colored text: "נכון — צפון רשת" and "מודדים מהכיוון של קווי הרשת אל קו היעד, עם כיוון השעון." Small secondary "למה לא האחרים?" link reveals definitions; its expanded state displays two concise rows with small compass and geographic-pole symbols "המצפן: צפון מגנטי" and "הקוטב הגאוגרפי: צפון אמיתי". Left two thirds: large gorgeous two-scale educational visual in same approved earth/map aesthetic. A top-down cream topographic paper map dominates, a clean physical olive lensatic compass rests near the lower-left map edge, modest miniature olive earth globe near upper-left shows geographic pole marker as comparison only. The map uses sparse clear contour labels, faint green square grid, a tiny sage "GN" north arrow perfectly parallel to vertical grid, A lower-middle and B upper-right connected by ONE orange ray. A clean green highlighted sweep measurement arc begins from GN and goes clockwise to route AB; the grid reference aligned grid highlighted sage; two unused small reference rays TN and MN are greyed but labelled. Magnifying lens inset at top of map illustrates "המדידה מתחילה מקווי הרשת", grid and north ray coherent. This is the result of a correct decision, not a navigation game with people or weapons. Bottom across card calm takeaway "מזהים את כלי המדידה — ואז בוחרים את הצפון המתאים." Bottom right primary orange button "למשימה הבאה" with RTL left-chevron and left quiet "נסו שוב".
